title: nan
authors: Ferreira B.A.; Ivanovic A.; Peti M.; Mandic L.; Batos M.; Domislovic J.; Vasiljevic G.; Obradovic J.; Ferreira F.; Petric F.; Barisic-Kulas A.; Car M.; Goricanec J.; Krasevac N.; Krizmancic M.; Loncar I.; Markovic L.; Milijas R.; Stuhne D.; Orsag M.; Bogdan S.; Miskovic N.
key_contribution: Presents a heterogeneous UAV-ASV multirobot system integrating sensor fusion, localization, and mission planning for maritime inspection in GNSS-denied scenarios, with field trial results.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
